Code Review 的新变化
编码智能体不断提升团队编写代码的速度，而代码审查的瓶颈却并未缓解。为实现正式可用，我们让 Code Review 更快、更擅长发现真正重要的 bug，并且更易于针对你的每个代码仓库进行调优。

inlines.text: 编码智能体不断提升团队编写代码的速度，而代码审查的瓶颈却并未缓解。为实现正式可用，我们让 Code Review 更快、更擅长发现真正重要的 bug，并且更易于针对你的每个代码仓库进行调优。

blocks.text: 自我们发布研究预览以来，Code Review 变得更加敏锐，捕获了更多原本会进入生产环境的 bug。我们还在 Anthropic 对拉取请求运行 Code Review，这让我们看到审查在哪些地方拖慢了自己工程师的速度。预览期间使用 Code Review 的团队也告诉了我们其余的情况：它能在人工审查者查看 PR 之前就发现真实问题，但他们希望审查更安静、规模与每次变更相匹配，并且更快。以下是我们交付的内容：

inlines.text: 以来，Code Review 变得更加敏锐，捕获了更多原本会进入生产环境的 bug。我们还在 Anthropic 对拉取请求运行 Code Review，这让我们看到审查在哪些地方拖慢了自己工程师的速度。预览期间使用 Code Review 的团队也告诉了我们其余的情况：它能在人工审查者查看 PR 之前就发现真实问题，但他们希望审查更安静、规模与每次变更相匹配，并且更快。以下是我们交付的内容：
与预览期间相比，大多数审查现在完成速度快约 3 倍（从约 20 分钟缩短至 6-10 分钟）。
发现更多真正重要的 bug，给出清晰、简洁的发现，用几句话说明问题、触发条件以及修复方法。
管理员可为每个代码仓库选择 Quick、Standard 或 Deep，让常规代码库获得快速审查，最关键的部分获得深度审查。每个级别都能提供高质量的审查。

What's new in Code Review

Coding agents keep increasing the pace at which teams write code, and the review bottleneck hasn't eased. For general availability, we made Code Review faster, better at finding the bugs that matter, and easier to tune to each of your repositories.

inlines.text: Coding agents keep increasing the pace at which teams write code, and the review bottleneck hasn't eased. For general availability, we made Code Review faster, better at finding the bugs that matter, and easier to tune to each of your repositories.

blocks.text: Since we released the research preview, Code Review has gotten sharper, catching more of the bugs that would otherwise reach production. We also run Code Review on pull requests at Anthropic, which shows us where reviews slow our own engineers down. Teams using Code Review during the preview told us the rest: it was catching real issues before a human reviewer looked at the PR, but they wanted reviews that were quieter, sized to each change, and faster. Here’s what we shipped:

inlines.text: , Code Review has gotten sharper, catching more of the bugs that would otherwise reach production. We also run Code Review on pull requests at Anthropic, which shows us where reviews slow our own engineers down. Teams using Code Review during the preview told us the rest: it was catching real issues before a human reviewer looked at the PR, but they wanted reviews that were quieter, sized to each change, and faster. Here’s what we shipped:
Most reviews now finish about 3x faster (~20 minutes down to 6-10 minutes) compared to during preview.
Find more of the bugs that matter, with clear, concise findings that state the problem, what triggers it, and the fix in a few sentences.
Admins choose Quick, Standard or Deep for each repository, so routine codebases get a quick pass and the most critical ones get a deep review. Every level delivers high-quality reviews.
